title: Academic Writing Task 2 — Evidence, Public Records and Institutional Trust
prompt: In many countries, public institutions now publish detailed records of their decisions, spending and performance online, and some commentators argue that this openness is the most effective way to build public trust. Others believe that the sheer volume of information released can confuse citizens and allow misleading claims to spread more easily than before. Discuss both views and give your own opinion on whether greater publication of institutional records strengthens or weakens public trust. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为综合模拟练习，所有情境与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。写作时请先分别说明两种观点各自的理由：公开记录如何可能增强信任，以及信息过载或误读如何可能削弱信任；随后给出你自己的明确立场，并用具体理由或例子支持。注意不要只罗列数据或描述现象，而要围绕“公开程度与公众信任之间的关系”展开论证。建议用约5分钟规划、30分钟写作、5分钟检查，确保回应题目全部要求并达到至少250词。
